_comment: Vetted, watermark-free meme clips for Zenie. Each was frame-checked clean. The drafting agent and the feedback agent pick the best-matching slug for a meme concept and write it to review-state.json as `meme_slug`; GitHub Actions renders meme_library/clips/<slug>.mp4 with the overlay text (fit-with-blur). NO-REPEAT RULE: a slug listed in meme_library/used.json has already been used and must NEVER be reused, even with a different caption — always pick from library minus used. When that set is empty, the library is exhausted; add new clips. To add a clip: source a clean HD GIF, frame-check every corner for watermarks/handles/network bugs, normalize to meme_library/clips/<slug>.mp4, and add an entry here. All clips render centered over a blurred background so the whole meme stays visible. SOURCING GOAL (Isabel's ruling, 2026-08-11): 'current trends, not current clips.' Clips are evergreen reaction formats and are NOT meant to track what is viral — currency comes from the overlay writing, which names a live trend. So when restocking, do not chase trendy footage; fill gaps in EMOTIONAL RANGE so every joke has a face that depicts it. Range currently covered: manic, overthinking, conflicted, awkward, chaotic, supportive, shocked, confident-exit, forced-smile, eye-roll, crying, scandalized, unbothered. Under-covered and worth sourcing next: exhausted/burnt out, suspicious/detective mode, delusional daydreaming, smug vindication, panicking. Target roughly 20 available (unused) clips; top up when it drops below ~6, which is about three weeks of runway at two memes per week. Use tools/source_meme_clips.py to harvest and register candidates.

clips.title: Kermit typing furiously
clips.use_when: Over-the-top, manic productivity or self-improvement energy — journaling, planning, or manifesting like you're single-handedly about to change your entire life at 3am.
clips.example_overlay: me at 3am journaling like i'm about to change my entire life

clips.title: Confused Math Lady (woman with floating equations)
vibes: trying to make it make sense
clips.use_when: Frantically calculating or overthinking something simple — decoding a text, doing relationship math. The woman looks completely out of her mind doing equations.
clips.example_overlay: me calculating exactly how long to wait before texting him back

clips.title: Kombucha Girl (skeptical taste then reconsidering)
clips.use_when: Conflicted, mixed-feelings reaction — something is questionable but you're weirdly into it, or you start out judging and end up reconsidering (red flags you're choosing to ignore).
clips.example_overlay: when he says he's 'not really looking for anything serious'

clips.title: Awkward Look Monkey Puppet (nervous side-eye)
clips.use_when: Awkward, caught-red-handed, or guilty side-eye energy — when you said/did something you shouldn't have, or a situation suddenly got uncomfortable.
clips.example_overlay: when she asks if i've been journaling and i lie

clips.title: This Is Fine dog (sitting calmly in a burning room)
vibes: everything is chaos but pretending it's okay
clips.use_when: Forced-calm-amid-total-chaos energy — pretending everything is fine while your life is on fire. Coping, denial, holding it together by a thread.
clips.example_overlay: me journaling 'today was a good day' after the worst week of my life

clips.title: Michael Jackson eating popcorn (Thriller)
clips.use_when: Sitting back and enjoying drama that isn't yours — watching the group chat or a friend's situationship implode while you snack.
clips.example_overlay: me reading the group chat while two of my friends fight over the same guy

clips.title: Disaster Girl (smirking in front of a house fire)
clips.use_when: Gleeful chaos / villain energy — when you caused the mess and aren't sorry, or you're thriving in the disaster.
clips.example_overlay: me walking away after telling my friend exactly what i think of her ex

clips.title: Side-Eyeing Chloe (skeptical little girl)
clips.use_when: Deeply skeptical, unimpressed side-eye — when someone says something you absolutely do not believe.
clips.example_overlay: when he says 'i barely even talk to my ex anymore'

clips.title: Kris Jenner 'you're doing amazing sweetie'
clips.use_when: Over-the-top supportive bestie/mom energy — hyping someone up no matter how questionable the decision.
clips.example_overlay: me to my bestie after she texts him back in 0.2 seconds

clips.title: Shocked reaction at an awards show
clips.use_when: Genuine shock / jaw-drop — reacting to surprising news or a plot twist.
clips.example_overlay: when she says they're 'just friends' but he liked all her 2019 photos

clips.title: SpongeBob 'imagination' rainbow hands
clips.use_when: Romanticizing or fantasizing about a delusional best-case scenario in your head after the smallest sign of interest.
clips.example_overlay: me planning our whole future after one decent text back

clips.title: Mocking SpongeBob (chicken pose)
clips.use_when: Sarcastically mocking or repeating back something someone said — classic mocking-SpongeBob energy.
clips.example_overlay: him: i'm just really bad at texting back

clips.title: Nick Young confused (face with question marks)
clips.use_when: Pure confusion — when something genuinely doesn't add up and you have visible question marks over your head.
clips.example_overlay: when he says he misses me but never once makes a plan

clips.title: Rihanna dramatic eye-roll
clips.use_when: Dramatic exasperation / over-it eye-roll — when someone says something tiring or you're done with the conversation.
clips.example_overlay: when he says 'you're kind of overreacting'

clips.title: Confident hair flip (Zendaya)
clips.use_when: Unbothered, confident, main-character energy — flipping your hair and moving on, didn't let it faze you.
clips.example_overlay: me leaving him on read after he took 3 days to reply

clips.title: Forced uncomfortable smile (Britney)
clips.use_when: Strained, forced-smile politeness — pretending to be fine or nice while internally not okay.
clips.example_overlay: smiling at his situationship in the group photo

clips.title: Tom & Jerry heart eyes (swooning)
clips.use_when: Head-over-heels, heart-eyes infatuation — catching feelings fast, down bad after the smallest thing.
clips.example_overlay: me after he remembered my coffee order one time

clips.title: Homer Simpson head exploding (mind blown)
clips.use_when: A realization or plot twist so big your brain explodes — sudden clarity or shocking info.
clips.example_overlay: realizing the 'ick' was just me finally having standards

clips.title: Anime rage table flip
clips.use_when: Explosive 'I'm done' rage — flipping the table on a frustrating situation.
clips.example_overlay: me after the third 'wyd' text with zero actual plans

clips.title: Jim Halpert deadpan camera stare
clips.use_when: Deadpan look-to-camera — silently dead inside or done, reacting to something absurd someone said.
clips.example_overlay: him: 'i don't really do labels' — me staring into the camera:

clips.title: Frustrated facepalm
clips.use_when: Frustrated facepalm / secondhand embarrassment — when someone (or you) does something facepalm-worthy.
clips.example_overlay: when he says 'i was gonna text but i fell asleep' for the 4th time

clips.title: Confident mic drop / walk-off
clips.use_when: Confident mic-drop / walk-away-victorious energy — you said what you said and you're done.
clips.example_overlay: me after telling him exactly why it won't work, then leaving

clips.title: Ugly-crying with a tissue
clips.use_when: Full-body emotional release — crying it out over a text, a memory, or genuinely nothing. Use when the joke is about FEELING the thing, not being cool about it.
clips.example_overlay: me rereading the journal entry from when i thought he was the one

clips.title: Gasping, hand on chest
clips.use_when: Scandalized reaction to gossip or a reveal — the bestie HEARING the story, not the one living it. Use when the joke is someone else's news landing.
clips.example_overlay: when she finally tells me what he actually said in the group chat

clips.title: Sipping a drink, completely unbothered
clips.use_when: Serene, petty detachment — you're out of the drama and quietly enjoying it. Sipping INSTEAD of reacting; use when the joke is restraint, not confrontation.
clips.example_overlay: watching him repeat the exact pattern i wrote about in january

clips.title: On the phone, visibly exasperated
clips.use_when: The joke is a CONVERSATION — calling the bestie to debrief, explaining yourself for the tenth time, or taking nonsense down the phone. She is mid-call and unimpressed.
clips.example_overlay: calling my bestie to explain why i'm giving him one more chance

clips.title: Wry, unimpressed grimace
clips.use_when: A small contained cringe — hearing something questionable and reacting with a tight knowing grimace rather than an outburst. Use when the joke is restraint, not drama.
clips.example_overlay: when she asks if i think he's actually changed

clips.title: Blank hollow stare into the middle distance
clips.use_when: Total flatline — the joke is the ABSENCE of a reaction. Burnout, one text too many, or hearing the same excuse for the third time.
clips.example_overlay: me hearing 'i've just been really busy' for the third week running

clips.title: Arms up, eyes closed, pure relief
clips.use_when: The exhale AFTER something resolves — a decision finally made, a text finally sent, a boundary that actually held. Not shock, not hype: release.
clips.example_overlay: me after finally leaving him on read for a whole 24 hours

clips.title: Eyes closed, hands centred, completely calm
clips.use_when: Deliberate, earned calm — the self-care punchline. She has done the inner work and is simply not being moved by this. Pairs with journaling and boundary jokes.
clips.example_overlay: me choosing not to reply to the 11pm 'you up' text

clips.title: Giggling and hiding her face, giddy
clips.use_when: Helpless delight — a crush landed, a text came through, something went RIGHT. The joke is being unable to play it cool.
clips.example_overlay: when he texts back within four minutes for once

clips.title: Knowing, self-satisfied smirk
clips.use_when: Quiet vindication — you called it, it happened, and you are saying nothing out loud. Use when the joke is being RIGHT, not being loud.
clips.example_overlay: watching the pattern i wrote about in my journal play out exactly on schedule

clips.title: Full-body open-handed shrug
vibes: what do you want me to say
clips.use_when: Openly admitting the indefensible — you did the thing, you know it was silly, and you have no argument. The hands ARE the punchline, so keep the overlay short.
clips.example_overlay: me explaining why i texted him first again
